readme: Declarative list read by tools/fetch-assets.mjs. Every entry is a Microsoft Rocketbox file (MIT) at one pinned commit, installed into the gitignored assets-src/people/ (never served). gitBlobSha1 and bytes are what the GitHub contents API lists for that commit; the gate refuses any download whose git blob id differs. sha256 is null until the first fetch: the gate then writes it back here and every later fetch and --verify must match it (commit the pinned hashes). Entries with a localFile are imported from assets-src/_import (verified copies of the Waltz reference files, sha256 already pinned) and never downloaded.
